name: LiveKit Meet
author: Sunbeam Studios
description: Adds a LiveKit video meeting to calendar events. Meeting URLs are generated server-side by the livekit-meet app.

buttonLabel.label: Button label
buttonLabel.description: Label shown on the calendar event action button.

autoSetLocation.label: Set meeting link automatically
autoSetLocation.description: When enabled, the generated meeting link is written directly into the event's meeting link field.

apiPath.label: Room API path
apiPath.description: Same-origin path the plugin POSTs to. This path must be proxied to the LiveKit Meet deployment.
